items.why: Hot inflation data revived odds of another Fed rate hike, sinking stocks and lifting the volatility index as traders hedged.
Chipmakers fell as the hot inflation report hit AI-related names; Nasdaq weakness dragged semiconductors down broadly.
AI and megacap tech dropped with the broader tape after inflation came in hot and rate-hike talk returned.
AI infrastructure sold off with chipmakers lower; CoreWeave's bond-yield scare added pressure on the AI trade.

market_note: S&P futures -1.11%, Nasdaq futures -1.76% at last check; VIX up 8.51%.
summary: Stocks sold off Wednesday after a hot inflation report put another Fed rate hike back in play. The S&P futures dropped about 1% while chipmakers and AI names led the declines.
